author: Y Combinator
description:
Varun Vummadi is the co-founder of Giga, a company that builds AI agents for customer support and works with DoorDash as well as a number of large telecom providers. 

At Startup School India, Varun sat down YC General Partner Ankit Gupta to discuss what made him decide to turn down a high paying quant job, go through multiple pivots, and how his team of eight was able to beat a 400 person competitor to land a contract with DoorDash. 

Apply to Y Combinator: https://www.ycombinator.com/apply
Work at a startup: https://www.ycombinator.com/jobs

00:00 — Intro
01:33 — Early Days & Origin Story

06:28 — Pivoting Away From Ed Tech
07:25 — Finding the Real Idea

10:00 — Winning DoorDash at 8 People
11:09 — What GigaML Looks Like Now
12:40 — Advice for College Students
15:51 — Why Charge Early?
17:33 — The Next Big Bet
18:43 — Running the Company on AI
20:19 — How They Hire Engineers
22:04 — Product Over Sale
title: Why Two IIT Engineers Turned Down $550K Jobs To Build A Startup
